For learner sessions: ask the learner to remove fake metadata, leave an innocent orientation marker intact, explain a missed OCR label, and explain why the final file is not a clinical anonymity certificate. Record completion, errors and misconceptions without personal information. A small pilot cannot establish clinical privacy or accessibility certification.
